note: The one sentence a visitor gives their Agent on https://yulab-smu.top/Rho/, in each language the page offers it, English first. It sends the Agent to doc/setup.md, which is SETUP.md: the commands are there, so change the steps there, not here.

en.text: Read https://yulab-smu.top/Rho/doc/setup.md and follow its steps to install and configure Rho for me.

zh-CN.text: 请阅读 https://yulab-smu.top/Rho/doc/setup.md 文档，按照步骤为我安装并配置 Rho。
